title: South of the River

source.title: South of the River
source.attribution: Brian’s adaptation of Tom Misch’s South of the River; not an exact transcription
source.referenceNote: Brian confirmed the note sequence and rhythmic grouping in 4/4 for this two-bar G-minor adaptation.

entrance: Beat 1 opens with a triplet-eighth rest followed by four sextuplet sixteenths (E–F–A–C). Low A lands on beat 2.
rhythmStatus: Straight sixteenths follow the sextuplet. High D lands on beat 4, followed by D♭–C–B within that beat. Quarter-note B♭ lands on bar 2 beat 1, with three beats of rest to finish the bar.

scaleContext.name: G minor / Dorian–blues
scaleContext.basis: The E–F–A–C opening adds a natural sixth to the G-minor sound. E♭ introduces the minor sixth later in bar 1, and D–D♭–C–B approaches B♭ chromatically. The final B♭ is the minor third of G and the seventh of the Cm7 backing chord.

applications.pattern: Two bars moving from i7 to iv7; example uses Gm7 then Cm7.
applications.matching: minor7, minor11, or minor for 4 beats on i followed by 4 beats on iv.

applications.pattern: Two full bars over static minor seventh; example uses Gm7.
applications.matching: minor7, minor11, or minor for 8 continuous beats.

applications.pattern: Same shapes shifted to the relative major I → IV (B♭maj7 → E♭maj7 in G minor).
applications.matching: Major7 or major6 for 4 beats on I followed by 4 beats on IV.

buildingBlocks.name: Sextuplet Run
buildingBlocks.sourceBeats: Bar 1 beats 1–2, including the sextuplet entrance rest

buildingBlocks.name: Chromatic Landing
buildingBlocks.sourceBeats: Bar 1 beats 3–4 plus the quarter-note B♭ on bar 2 beat 1
buildingBlocks.learnHarmony: One bar of Gm7 then one bar of Cm7, with the landing on bar 2 beat 1

halfTimePractice.appliesTo: Learn and Master for the full phrase and both building blocks. Integrate uses the original rhythm and chart placements.
halfTimePractice.entrance: The opening rest and E–F–A–C form an eighth-note sextuplet across beats 1–2. The straight eighths begin on beat 3.
halfTimePractice.learnHarmony: Two bars of Gm7 then one of Cm7. Half-note B♭ lands on bar 3 beat 1.
